headline.text: Your Excel model is wrong 23% of the time.

subheadline.text: Larkfield Signal delivers SKU-level demand forecasting that cuts overstock by 34% and stockouts by 28%. No PhD required.

feature_1_body.text: Stop guessing. Our models predict demand at the individual SKU level, accounting for seasonality, promotions, and external signals.

feature_2_body.text: Get notified the moment your forecast deviates from actuals. Catch problems before they become write-downs.

feature_3_body.text: Export clean forecasts directly into your existing spreadsheets. No new dashboards to learn, no IT project required.

social_proof_body.text: From boutique shops to national chains, teams rely on Larkfield Signal to keep shelves stocked and capital working.

security_body.text: SOC 2 Type II certified. Your data is encrypted at rest and in transit. We never train models on your proprietary data.

final_cta_body.text: Join 200+ retailers who cut waste and capture more sales with SKU-level forecasting.
